name: TeamStarWolf - Data Collection & Exfiltration
description: Curated practitioner view of Data Collection & Exfiltration behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping. Staging and moving data out: collection of local, network, cloud, and application data, packaging, and exfiltration over C2, alternative protocols, web services, or physical media. Cross-tactic selection of Enterprise ATT&CK techniques; scores indicate curated membership tier (core vs supporting), not incident frequency. Every technique ID and tactic is validated against the workbench's bundled ATT&CK v19.2 data.
